task_description: Build Phase 1 Core Foundation of ARES-X - a military-grade cyber battlefield and infrastructure resilience platform. Monorepo with Next.js frontend, Go API gateway and asset service, Rust graph engine, Python attack path engine, protobuf definitions, deployment configs, and documentation.

verification.summary: Go API Gateway and Asset Service both compile and pass go vet (stdlib only, zero external deps). All 17 Python files pass AST parsing. Rust code is syntactically valid (cannot cargo build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - external crates needed). All 32 TypeScript/TSX files verified syntactically valid. Docker build skipped (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). Tests skipped (no test framework available without network to install dependencies). Total: 130+ production files across 9 directories.
